Create an environment from a definition (JSON, checked against docs/environment.schema.json) or a pointer to a file.

Usage: termag environment create <name> (--file <path.json> | - | --pointer <owner/name>:<branch>:<path>) [--shared]

--file reads the definition (environment.json's JSON, with "repos" and "resources") from a file, and - from stdin.
--pointer <owner/name>:<branch>:<path> points at a file in a repository instead, read from that branch when a box is
made; an empty branch is the default branch, an empty path .termag/environment.json.
It is personal, yours alone, unless --shared (admins only): everyone signed in may then use it, only admins
change it, and it must be a --pointer to a file on its repository's default branch. Then deploy from it:
  termag project create <box>/<name> --agent claude --new-box --environment <name>

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
